top.title: Al Maktoum International accelerates toward world's biggest airport status
top.teaser: Al Maktoum International Airport is poised to become the world's largest aviation hub, with Dubai World Central (DWC) confirming that its second runway will become operational next year as scheduled. The milestone is expected to boost the airport's annual passenger handling capacity to 150 million during the first phase of the mega-expansion project, which is due to open in 2032.
